about_short_description.short_description: Automech Group specializes in various businesses that include engineering, steel, marine, dewatering, energy, and machines.

product.name: Steel Fabrication
product.description: Provides end-to-end steel fabrication services including machining, coating, painting, heat treatment, and heavy fabrication for various industries.

product.name: Dewatering Services and Equipment
product.description: Offers dewatering solutions including pumps, hoses, filtration systems, and water management plans to control groundwater and remove excess water from sites.

product.name: Precision Engineering and CNC Machining
product.description: Delivers high-precision manufacturing and machining services using CNC machines for complex components across multiple industries.

product.name: Marine Engine Services
product.description: Provides engine repair, maintenance, and overhauling services for marine vessels to ensure operational efficiency and compliance.

product.name: Contracting Services
product.description: Delivers contracting solutions including assembly, construction, and installation of fabricated components and structures for industrial projects.

product.name: Manufacturing Services
product.description: Manufactures specialized machinery, components, and equipment tailored to client specifications across various industries.
